steps.name: Prepare environment and persist CI for headless runs; validate Node/npm versions safely
steps.description: Verify node and npm exist and that Node major version is >=16 (fatal). Warn (but do not exit) when npm major is <8. Persist CI=true globally via /etc/profile.d/nsdl_ci.sh idempotently. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126431/NSDL.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126431/NSDL"
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found in PATH; container baseline expected nodejs." >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found in PATH; container baseline expected npm." >&2; exit 2; }
# robust major version extraction
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E 's/^v?([0-9]+).*$/\1/' || echo 0)
NPM_MAJOR=$(npm -v | sed -E 's/^0*([0-9]+).*$/\1/' || echo 0)
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then echo "ERROR: node v16+ required (found $(node -v)). Please use an image with Node >=16." >&2; exit 3; fi
if [ "${NPM_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 8 ]; then echo "WARNING: npm v8+ recommended (found $(npm -v)). Proceeding, but consider upgrading npm if installs fail." >&2; fi
# Idempotent CI profile fragment (only CI) - do not include workspace-specific PATH
CMS_FILE=/etc/profile.d/nsdl_ci.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# NSDL frontend headless env - CI mode
export CI=true
# NODE_ENV intentionally not persisted globally
EOF
if ! sudo test -f "$CMS_FILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$CMS_FILE"; then
  sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$TMP" "$CMS_FILE"
fi
rm -f "$TMP"
# quick verification output
echo "node=$(node -v) npm=$(npm -v)"

steps.name: Install project dependencies and local tooling deterministically
steps.description: Install node deps non-interactively in workspace. Use npm ci when package-lock.json exists, otherwise use yarn when yarn.lock exists, else npm install. When adding missing devDependencies prefer the project's package manager (yarn when yarn.lock present). Do NOT persist workspace-specific PATH into /etc/profile.d; rely on local node_modules/.bin when running commands.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126431/NSDL"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing - run scaffold step" >&2; exit 2; }
# Choose deterministic installer
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo "npm ci failed" >&2; exit 3; }
elif [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null; then
  yarn install --silent || { echo "yarn install failed" >&2; exit 3; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo "npm install failed" >&2; exit 3; }
fi
# helper to check for dep in package.json (fixed argv indexing)
has_dep(){ node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); const k=process.argv[1]; if((p.dependencies&&p.dependencies[k])||(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies[k])) process.exit(0); else process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(2);}" "$1"; }
# Determine package manager for adding deps
USE_YARN=0
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null; then USE_YARN=1; fi
# Install jest only if not available locally (image has global jest but prefer local for reproducibility)
if ! has_dep jest >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $USE_YARN -eq 1 ]; then
  yarn add --dev jest@^29 --silent || { echo "yarn add jest failed" >&2; exit 4; }
elif ! has_dep jest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --save-dev jest@^29 || { echo "npm install jest failed" >&2; exit 4; }
fi
# Install serve only if not present locally and project is static-build oriented
if ! has_dep serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ $USE_YARN -eq 1 ]; then
    yarn add --dev serve@^14 --silent || { echo "yarn add serve failed" >&2; exit 5; }
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --save-dev serve@^14 || { echo "npm install serve failed" >&2; exit 5; }
  fi
fi
# Verify local binaries exist (no global PATH mutating)
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest" ]; then "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/jest" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" ]; then "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
